class.name: WorldBaseElevationDecorator
class.brief_description: Inherited reference elevation for descendant terrain profiles.
class.description: Authoring metadata resolved root-to-leaf before immutable modifiers are compiled. Applies to terrain profiles and ravine reference levels, without moving container bounds, nodes, or explicitly positioned sphere decorators. Requires a terrain profile to create a surface; metadata alone does not replace the base Y=0 field. Disabled entries are ignored; multiple entries on the same container resolve in list order. Priority does not affect metadata. Shared Resources are never modified to implement inheritance.

members.member: Reference elevation in metres. Terrain profile elevation remains an additional local offset. Node translation is additional.
When true, adds elevation to the inherited value; otherwise replaces it for this container and descendants.
